en: The image is a vintage postcard depicting a grand staircase leading up through lush gardens to a large, elegant residence with a red-tiled roof. The house is framed by greenery and blooming flowers, and there are pergolas on either side of the staircase. The colors are somewhat faded, suggesting an old photograph or hand-tinted image. The bottom of the postcard features printed text in red.
